shots.visual: 九十九盏魂灯同时点燃，火浪扑向祭柱，被铁链绑住的林昭在火光里缓缓抬头。
shots.action: 魂灯齐燃、火浪扑向祭柱
shots.prompt_en: 99 soul lanterns igniting simultaneously, blazing fire wave surging toward sacrificial pillar, Lin Zhao bound by iron chains, slowly raising head amid firelight, night altar, dramatic orange glow

shots.visual: 祭天台全景，魂灯围成圆阵，雷云压顶翻涌，众弟子持剑列阵，火光在风里摇晃。
shots.prompt_en: panoramic view of sacrificial altar, soul lamps forming circular array, surging thunderclouds overhead, disciples holding swords in formation, flickering firelight in wind, dramatic storm lighting

shots.visual: 苏璃握剑的手部特写，指节泛白，剑柄缠绳被攥出褶皱，背景是严崇在高台宣令的虚化身影。
shots.dialogue: 严崇（画外）：解封献祭，全宗同证。
shots.prompt_en: close-up of Su Li's hand gripping sword hilt, whitened knuckles, wrinkled cord-wrapped handle, blurred figure of Yan Chong proclaiming decree on high platform in background, cold dim lighting

shots.visual: 七名长老合力挥剑斩向林昭胸口锁链，金光迸裂，第一道锁应声而断，气浪掀飞魂灯。
shots.prompt_en: seven elders, swinging swords together, slashing chains on Lin Zhao's chest, golden light bursting, first chain snapping apart, shockwave blowing away soul lamps, dark hall, glowing golden light

shots.visual: 天雷如瀑布砸落，锁链虚影暴涨成穹顶护住全宗，反震之力把三名长老震得倒飞出去。
shots.action: 天雷砸落、锁链成穹顶、长老被震飞
shots.prompt_en: heavenly lightning crashing down like waterfall, giant chain phantom expanding into dome barrier protecting sect, three elders blasted backward mid-air, recoil shockwave, night sky, harsh lightning glow

shots.visual: 林昭跪在焦土中央毫发无伤，四周横七竖八倒着焦黑的人影，他低头看胸口；云层裂开一只金瞳。
shots.dialogue: 林昭：原来……护我的，从来不是他们。
shots.prompt_en: Lin Zhao kneeling unharmed at center of scorched earth, charred black silhouettes sprawled around him, looking down at his own chest, cracked clouds revealing a giant golden eye, dim ember glow
